execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the first no-referral mint sends its commission to the founder because no existing NFT is available, while later no-referral mints use VRF to select an existing NFT.

patches.decision_note: The source does not state that the first mint receives no ticket; that unsupported assertion must be removed from the implementation claim.
The requested four-by-four badge grid is a badge-layout change and does not specify mobile-responsive behavior; it is already correctly represented under REQ_ACHIEVEMENT_BADGES.
The phrase 'Also, this tweak' lacks the referenced attachment or text, so the affected Requirement and any state change cannot be identified safely.

The original obligation reserves mints 1, 2, and 3 for the client, while the later transfer request and completion claim explicitly address only mint 1; review is needed to determine whether mints 2 and 3 remain outstanding.
It is unclear whether the later instruction to finish Transak resumes only REQ_FIAT_ONRAMP or also the deferred REQ_FIAT_BUYER_WALLET_ACCESS experience.
